title: Castaic Landing Boat Rentals

blurb: Rent fishing boats at Castaic Lake's West Ramp to fish, sightsee, or enjoy a day on the water. Rentals include fuel, life jackets, paddle, and anchor. The lake is open Wednesday through Sunday with no reservations accepted; rentals are first come, first served.
extraNote: No reservations accepted; rentals are first come, first served · Senior Discount: 20% off all-day rentals Monday–Friday for seniors 65+ (excludes holidays) · Deposits may be forfeited for late return, damage, or unclean boat · Castaic Lake closed Mondays and Tuesdays until further notice · All RMRC and lake rules must be followed · West Ramp at Castaic Lake · Year-round; closed Mondays and Tuesdays until further notice
